svg.title: The actual finite local types are row-energy remainders indexed by signed orientation and row, diagonal logarithmic corrections indexed by fine bond, and Haar-chart corrections indexed by active fine bond. Alongside inherited logarithms, the five chain types are real-plate principal log chains with coefficient −1/2, blank-plate chains with +1/2, covariance correction chains with +1/2, affine first corrections and residual quadratic chains. Chain length is the extra charge; the affine bond term has charge zero. Supports are full receipts enlarged by lB, including every lookup. The lifted record retains all these tags, supports and parameter choices; readout recovers the uniform weights before field evaluation. The local four-coordinate Taylor map is recovered before restricting periodic coordinates, so its bound and (NF5) transport without treating coincident coordinates as independent physical variables.
